name: io.github.sepehr071/okala-mcp
title: Okala
description: Unofficial read-only Okala: grocery stores that deliver to you, compare prices across stores.

environmentVariables.name: OKALA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for requests to okala.com; system proxy settings are ignored.

environmentVariables.name: OKALA_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Okala access token for text search; normally saved by `okala-mcp login` instead.
